criteria.text: an auto-apply → keep round-trip: drive the loop to auto-apply a revision to a managed skill (improvement passes), confirm the managed SKILL.md changed, the reloaded GET /skill reflects it, and the sidecar row is status='active' with post_score > baseline_score persisted.
criteria.test_id: issue-798-c1: managed auto-apply keep round-trip against built fork

criteria.text: an auto-apply → auto-revert restores byte-identical prior version assertion (managed): apply a revision that does NOT improve (force a non-improving judge score / injected measurement), confirm the loop reverts, and assert the live managed SKILL.md is byte-identical to the pre-apply content (capture bytes before, compare after revert) and the sidecar row is status='reverted'.
criteria.test_id: issue-798-c2: managed auto-revert restores the prior SKILL.md byte-identically

criteria.text: an external-skill never-mutated-in-place assertion: stage an external skill outside the managed dir, run the auto-apply path for it (→ a same-name managed shadow appears), and assert the original external file's bytes are UNCHANGED; then force a revert and assert (a) the managed shadow is removed, (b) the external original is live again, and (c) the external file's bytes are STILL unchanged across the entire apply→revert cycle.
criteria.test_id: issue-798-c3: an external skill is unchanged and restored live after shadow revert

criteria.text: the existing names-alignment invariant still holds: every derived allowed_skills_json name ⊆ live GET /skill names; the same-name managed shadow adds NO new name, so the subset relation is trivially preserved.
criteria.test_id: issue-798-c4: unified metadata names mirror the fork set and a shadow adds no name

criteria.text: apps/api_server/src/__tests__/skill_names_alignment.test.ts is extended (or a sibling test added) to cover: the unified read (?withMetadata=true) name set mirrors the fork name set; a same-name shadow does not duplicate or add a name; a status='measuring' or 'reverted' row does not leak into the live skill name set; and status only ever takes active/measuring/reverted (no proposed/approved/rejected).
criteria.test_id: issue-798-c5: sidecar-only measuring/reverted rows do not leak into live names
